text: Bolivia has **short, white licence plates** with blue text. The blue text can be hard to see through the blur, so plates might appear as plain white.
text_zh: 玻利維亞擁有帶有藍字的**短版白色車牌**。透過模糊處理可能很難看清藍字，因此車牌看起來可能只是純白色。

text: Bolivia only has Generation 3 camera coverage. All of the country was covered by a solid **white Google car with no antenna**.
NOTE: In Latin America, white cars with no antenna can also be found in Peru and Chile.
text_zh: 玻利維亞只有第 3 代相機街景覆蓋。該國全境都是由一輛純**無天線白色 Google 車**拍攝的。
注意：在拉丁美洲，秘魯和智利也能找到無天線的白色 Google 車。

text: Many buildings in Bolivia consist of** large red bricks**. Buildings often have an ‘unfinished' look.
NOTE: This style of architecture is also common in parts of Peru.
text_zh: 玻利維亞的許多建築都是由**大型紅磚**建造的。建築物通常看起來有種「未完工」的感覺。
注意：這種建築風格在秘魯的部分地區也很常見。

text: **Middle road lines** can be all-yellow, yellow and white, or all-white, while **outer road lines** are always white.

NOTE: Road lines in Chile are always all-white or all-yellow, never a combination of the two. In Peru, you can find roads having outer lines with no middle line. Such outer line-only roads are very rare in Bolivia.
text_zh: **道路中線**可以是全黃色、黃白相間或全白色，而**外側道路標線**則永遠是白色。
注意：智利的道路標線永遠是全白或全黃，絕不會是兩者組合。在秘魯，你可以找到有外側線但沒有中線的道路。這種只有外側線的道路在玻利維亞非常罕見。

text: Bolivia has a lot of standard asphalt roads, but **concrete slab roads** are also fairly common.
text_zh: 玻利維亞有很多標準的柏油路，但**水泥板路**也相當常見。

text: There are also a lot of **cobblestone roads**. These roads often have a specific pattern, with several neat lines of stones separating the more disorganised cobblestones in between.
text_zh: 還有很多**鵝卵石路**。這些道路通常有特定的圖樣，有幾排整齊的石頭隔開中間較不整齊的鵝卵石。

text: Bolivia typically uses **bulky, white square signposts**.
NOTE: Peru typically uses black and white striped “zebra” signposts.
text_zh: 玻利維亞通常使用**笨重、白色的方形標誌桿**。
注意：秘魯通常使用黑白條紋的「斑馬」標誌桿。

text: Guardrails sometimes feature **yellow and black **markings. These markings always have the yellow stripes on the outside.
NOTE: Peru has similar markings. However, in Peru, the markings have the inverse colour scheme: the black stripes are always on the outside.
text_zh: 護欄有時會帶有**黃黑相間 **標記。這些標記的黃色條紋永遠在最外側。
注意：秘魯有類似的標記。然而在秘魯，標記的顏色配色相反：黑色條紋永遠在最外側。

text: Two types of **utility poles** are common in Bolivia:
- Round concrete poles, often with small pinholes near the top.
- Wooden poles.

Poles in Bolivia are very inconsistent and should not be relied on too much. Poles can have a variety of pole tops. On rare occasions, you can find [Argentina-style concrete poles](https://goo.gl/maps/UythNAbXVFHvDYp56).
text_zh: 玻利維亞常見兩種類型的**電線桿**：
- 圓形水泥桿，頂部附近通常有小針孔。
- 木桿。
玻利維亞的電線桿非常不一致，不應過度依賴。桿頂樣式多樣。在極少數情況下，你可以找到[阿根廷風格的水泥桿](https://goo.gl/maps/UythNAbXVFHvDYp56)。

text: Many wooden utility poles, particularly in the eastern parts of Bolivia’s Street View coverage, are noticeably **curvy **and look like they are made from locally sourced tree trunks.
NOTE: While you may see slightly bent poles in other places, extremely curvy poles are a very good clue for Bolivia.
text_zh: 許多木製電線桿，特別是在玻利維亞東部街景覆蓋區域，都明顯**彎曲 **，看起來就像是用當地樹幹製作的。
注意：雖然你可能在其他地方看到稍微彎曲的電線桿，但極度彎曲的電線桿是玻利維亞非常好的線索。

text: **Kilometre markers** are black and white. The top part is black and features the abbreviation ‘Km’, while the bottom part is white and shows the distance. These markers do not have road numbers.
NOTE: They can look somewhat similar to Argentinian road markers, especially from a distance. The main difference is that the markers in Argentina feature a road number.
text_zh: **公里碑**是黑白相間的。頂部是黑色的，帶有縮寫「Km」，而底部是白色的，顯示距離。這些里程碑沒有道路編號。
注意：它們看起來與阿根廷的道路里程碑有點相似，特別是從遠處看。主要的差別是阿根廷的里程碑帶有道路編號。

text: Many Bolivians wear **traditional clothing**, especially women. Folk dress for women typically consists of bowler hats, colourful shawls, and big pleated skirts ([pollera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pollera#Bolivia_and_Peru)).
NOTE: Similar folk dress can sometimes be found in parts of Peru, especially those close to Bolivia.
text_zh: 許多玻利維亞人穿著**傳統服飾**，尤其是女性。女性的民俗服飾通常包括圓頂硬禮帽、色彩繽紛的披肩以及大型打褶裙 ([pollera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pollera#Bolivia_and_Peru))。
注意：類似的傳統服裝有時可以在秘魯的部分地區看到，特別是靠近玻利維亞的區域。

text: At the time Bolivia was covered by Street View, its ruling political party was the Movimiento al Socialismo (**MAS**). Political graffiti often features the words MAS and **Evo**, short for then-president Evo Morales.
Additionally, many random objects are painted in the party’s colours: **black, white, and a large blue field**. This distinctive colour scheme is a good clue for Bolivia.
text_zh: 在玻利維亞被街景覆蓋時，其執政黨是爭取社會主義運動 (**MAS**)。政治塗鴉經常出現 MAS 和 **Evo**（時任總統埃沃·莫拉雷斯的簡稱）。
此外，許多隨機物品都被漆上了該黨派的顏色：**黑色、白色和一大片藍色**。這種獨特的配色方案是玻利維亞的好線索。

text: Bolivia has a **second official flag**, called the [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala). It is a square patchwork of seven diagonally arranged colours. It is sometimes seen on government buildings and project signs.
text_zh: 玻利維亞有一面**第二官方國旗**，稱為 [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala)。它是一個由七種對角排列顏色組成的方形拼布旗幟。有時可以在政府大樓和工程標誌上看到它。

text: In urban areas, you will often see ads for the telecom company **Tigo**, with its distinct blue logo. Crucially, this company does not operate in Peru, meaning it can help you solve urban 50-50s.
NOTE: This company does operate in several other Latin American countries, so only use this tip to differentiate between Peru and Bolivia.
text_zh: 在市區，你經常會看到電信公司 **Tigo** 的廣告，帶有其獨特的藍色標誌。最重要的是，這家公司在祕魯沒有業務，這意味著它能幫你破解市區的 50-50 二選一。
注意：該公司確實有在拉丁美洲的其他幾個國家營運，因此請僅使用此技巧來區分秘魯和玻利維亞。

text: If all else fails, and you have a tough 50-50, it can help to look at the colour of the rocks and soil, which often have a distinct **reddish tint** in Bolivia, more so than the other Andean countries.
This information should be used with a fair amount of caution, as there are many variables. Only use it when you have no other clues available.
text_zh: 如果其他方法都失敗了，而你面臨棘手的二選一，觀察岩石和土壤的顏色可能會有所幫助，玻利維亞的岩石和土壤通常帶有明顯的**偏紅基調**，比其他安地斯山脈國家更為明顯。
這項資訊使用時應相當謹慎，因為變數很多。請僅在沒有其他線索可用時才使用它。

text: Coverage in Bolivia is **very limited**, both in geographic scope and the density of roads covered.

Only the central and central-western parts of the country have coverage. Most coverage is found in and around the six main cities of La Paz or El Alto, Cochabamba, Oruro, Sucre, Potosi, and Santa Cruz.

These aforementioned six cities have in-depth side-street coverage. Outside these cities, coverage is mostly limited to main roads. Beware that “main road” is a relative concept in Bolivia: many of these, even some that are marked yellow on the map, have large unpaved sections.
text_zh: 玻利維亞的街景覆蓋**非常有限**，無論是在地理範圍還是在涵蓋的道路密度方面。
只有該國的中部和中西部地區有街景覆蓋。大部分覆蓋位於拉巴斯（La Paz）或埃爾阿爾托（El Alto）、科恰班巴（Cochabamba）、歐魯羅（Oruro）、蘇克雷（Sucre）、波托西（Potosi）和聖克魯斯（Santa Cruz）這六個主要城市及其周邊地區。
上述這六個城市擁有深入的次要街道覆蓋。在這些城市之外，街景覆蓋大多僅限於主要道路。請注意，在玻利維亞「主要道路」是一個相對的概念：其中許多道路，甚至有些在地圖上標示為黃色的道路，都有大段未鋪設路面的路段。

text: The **Altiplano** (“high plain”) is an immense highland plateau that dominates most of western Bolivia. It is covered in grasslands that range from green to arid. Some parts are suitable for [agriculture](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6), whereas other parts are [extremely dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6). Grass growing in [tufts](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6) is common (sometimes referred to as “Bolivian hedgehogs” in the community).
NOTE: While it is generally fairly flat, you will often see [hills and mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6) around you. However, as a general rule, the road itself will be mostly flat.
text_zh: **阿爾蒂普拉諾高原**（Altiplano，意為「高平原」）是一座廣袤的高山高原，占據了玻利維亞西部的大部分地區。這裡覆蓋著從綠色到乾旱不等的草原。有些部分適合[農業](https://goo.gl/maps/KmBznqSbPKfSGGBF6)，而其他部分則[極度乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cr2y2FLrMe2nne7R6)。成[叢](https://goo.gl/maps/j7Tb5hpmkUkxZ8Bt6)生長的草很常見（社群有時稱之為「玻利維亞刺蝟」）。
註：雖然這裡整體來說相當平坦，但你經常會在四周看到[丘陵與山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NYUhe5JZvzW1EZTF6)。不過原則上，道路本身大多是平坦的。

text: The grasslands of the Altiplano tend to look more **lush** in the more northern half: the area close to El Alto and La Paz.
NOTE: Due to seasonal coverage, there are some exceptions to this, but in general this is a good rule of thumb to distinguish between the different parts of the Altiplano.
text_zh: 阿爾蒂普拉諾高原的草原在北半部通常看起來更為**生機盎然**：即靠近埃爾阿爾托（El Alto）和拉巴斯（La Paz）的區域。
註：由於季節性街景覆蓋的原因，這點有一些例外，但總體而言，這是區分阿爾蒂普拉諾高原不同區域的好方法。

text: Conversely, the Altiplano looks more **arid** in the more southern half: around Oruro, and the roads going southwest towards Chile.
NOTE: There is one major exception to this: one driving side of the divided part of Ruta 1 looks somewhat green all the way up to Oruro (due to this coverage being captured in a different season).
text_zh: 相反地，阿爾蒂普拉諾高原在南半部看起來更加**乾旱**：例如奧魯羅（Oruro）周圍，以及向西南延伸通往智利的道路。
註：這裡有一個主要的例外：Ruta 1 分隔島路段的其中一個車道方向一路延伸到奧魯羅看起來都有些綠意（因為這段街景覆蓋是在不同季節拍攝的）。

text: **Lake Titicaca**, on the border with Peru, is the most significant body of water in Bolivia. It is located entirely within the Altiplano. It can be seen from two roads:
- The section of Ruta 1 between Desaguadero and Guaqui. Here, the lake will always be to your north.
- The section of Ruta 2 between San Pablo de Tiquina and Batallas. Here, the lake will mostly be to your south or west.
The landscape around Titicaca is very green, compared to most of the western half of Bolivia.
text_zh: **的的喀喀湖**（Lake Titicaca）部位於與秘魯交界之處，是玻利維亞最重要的水體。它完全位於阿爾蒂普拉諾高原內。從兩條道路上可以看到它：
- Ruta 1 位於 Desaguadero 和 Guaqui 之間的路段。在這裡，湖泊永遠位於你的北方。
- Ruta 2 位於 San Pablo de Tiquina 和 Batallas 之間的路段。在這裡，湖泊大多位於你的南方或西方。
與玻利維亞西部的大部分地區相比，的的喀喀湖周圍的景觀非常翠綠。

text: If you are surrounded by tall mountains, you are likely in the Andes, which goes roughly northwest to southeast in between the Altiplano and the Amazon rainforest.
NOTE: The Altiplano has several [smaller](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xg1B6p6zANJpMNSF9) and [solitary](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pi1ydWitmQto2HLa6) mountains.
text_zh: 如果你被高山環繞，你很可能身處安地斯山脈中，它大致呈西北至東南走向，夾在阿爾蒂普拉諾高原和亞馬遜雨林之間。
註：阿爾蒂普拉諾高原上有一些[較小](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xg1B6p6zANJpMNSF9)且[孤立](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pi1ydWitmQto2HLa6)的山峰。

text: The area east of the Andes is very **green and tropical**, with lots of **agriculture** – especially around Santa Cruz. This area is mostly very flat, though you will see [large hills](https://goo.gl/maps/hmDHHLaabGBL3bnV8) on some of the roads closer to the Andes. The soil tends to have a pink colour.
text_zh: 安地斯山脈以東的地區非常**翠綠且具熱帶風情**，有許多**農業活動**——特別是在聖克魯斯（Santa Cruz）周圍。這個區域大部分非常平坦，但在靠近安地斯山脈的一些道路上會看到[大型丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/hmDHHLaabGBL3bnV8)。土壤往往呈粉紅色。

text: Within this tropical area, coverage on **unpaved roads** is only found around Santa Cruz. These roads again prominently have the pink soil that is very characteristic of the area east of Andes.
text_zh: 在這個熱帶區域內，**未鋪設路面**的街景覆蓋僅出現在聖克魯斯周圍。這些道路同樣顯著地帶有粉紅色的土壤，這是安地斯山脈以東地區非常鮮明的特徵。

text: Aside from being a useful identifier for the country, **cobblestone roads** are mainly found in and southeast of Cochabamba. They also appear around Sucre and, very rarely, in La Paz.
text_zh: **鵝卵石路**除了是辨識該國的實用特徵外，主要分布在科查班巴（Cochabamba）境內及其東南部。它們也會出現在蘇克雷（Sucre）周圍，極少數出現在拉巴斯。

text: La Paz and El Alto are **twin cities** that together form one big metropolitan area. However, despite being located right next to each other, they each have a very different look. See the tips below for more information.
text_zh: 拉巴斯和埃爾阿爾托是**雙子城**，共同組成一個大型都會區。然而，儘管它們緊鄰彼此，外觀卻截然不同。請參閱下方提示以取得更多資訊。

text: La Paz is a very **hilly** city. Most of La Paz itself is situated in meandering valleys, surrounded by hills that often tend to be covered in **green vegetation** (as opposed to the more dry hillsides found in many other Bolivian urban areas).
text_zh: 拉巴斯是一座非常**多丘陵**的城市。拉巴斯本身的大部分區域位於蜿蜒的山谷中，四周環繞著丘陵，這些丘陵往往覆蓋著**綠色植被**（與玻利維亞許多其他城鎮較乾旱的山坡形成鮮明對比）。

text: Downtown La Paz is the only place in Bolivia where you will find **very tall buildings** (10+ storeys).
text_zh: 拉巴斯市中心是玻利維亞唯一能看到**非常高的建築物**（10 層樓以上）的地方。

text: In many parts of La Paz, you can see these heavily eroded, **pillar-like rock formations** on the hillsides. They consist of a very recognizable yellow-beige sandstone.
Of the big cities with coverage in Bolivia, these rock formations are essentially unique to La Paz.
text_zh: 在拉巴斯的許多地方，你可以看到山坡上這些受嚴重侵蝕的**柱狀岩石地貌**。它們由非常容易辨認的黃米色砂岩組成。
在玻利維亞有街景覆蓋的大城市中，這種岩石地貌基本上是拉巴斯獨有的。

text: El Alto is situated on a very **flat, highland plateau**. It looks much drier and dustier than La Paz. The layout of its streets is also more regular and grid-like.
The city appears like an unending mess of semi-finished red brick buildings, even more so than other cities in Bolivia. Some neighbourhoods have a very rundown, desolate look.
text_zh: 埃爾阿爾托部位於非常**平坦的高山高原**上。它看起來比拉巴斯乾燥且多灰塵得多。其街道布局也更加規整、呈棋盤格狀。
這座城市看起來就像綿延不絕的半成品紅磚建築群，甚至比玻利維亞的其他城市更為明顯。有些社區看起來相當破舊荒涼。

text: This type of pavement, consisting of rectangular **grey bricks **with slightly wavy edges, is very common in El Alto.
text_zh: 這種由邊緣微波浪狀的矩形**灰色磚塊 **鋪成的路面，在埃爾阿爾托非常常見。

text: In El Alto, you can sometimes see a local type of architecture referred to as [**Neo-Andean**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neo-Andean). Buildings in this style are colourful, with elaborate, futuristic-looking façades. The style is really unique and is almost completely limited to El Alto.
text_zh: 在埃爾阿爾托，你偶爾可以看到一種被稱為[**新安地斯風格**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neo-Andean)的當地建築。這種風格的建築色彩鮮豔，具有精緻且富未來感的外觀立面。這種風格非常獨特，且幾乎完全僅見於埃爾阿爾托。

text: Gates and doors in El Alto are sometimes painted with a **gradient pattern**, usually dark green to light green, or red to yellow.
text_zh: 埃爾阿爾托的大門和門戶有時會塗上**漸層圖案**，通常是深綠到淺綠，或是紅到黃。

text: Cochabamba is situated in a large flat valley, where you will almost always see an imposing wall of** mountains to your north**. This is the single most useful and consistent way of distinguishing this city from other places in Bolivia.
text_zh: 科查班巴位於一個廣闊平坦的山谷中，你幾乎總能看到北方有一座令人印象深刻的** 牆狀山脈**。這是將這座城市與玻利維亞其他地方區分開來最實用且一致的方法。

text: Of all the major cities in Bolivia, Oruro is situated in by far the most **dry landscape**.
In Oruro, you will also usually be able to see a large **dry hill to your west**, in an otherwise mostly flat and very arid landscape.
NOTE: Potosí is also located in an arid landscape. However, it is considerably hillier.
text_zh: 在玻利維亞的所有主要城市中，奧魯羅所處的景觀是迄今最為**乾旱的**。
在奧魯羅，在大部分平坦且極度乾旱的景觀中，你通常還能在**西方看到一座乾旱的大丘陵**。
註：波托西（Potosí）也部位於乾旱的景觀中。不過，它的地形要多丘陵得多。

text: Sucre is situated in a very hilly landscape, and as a result you can see many elevation changes in its streets. Uniquely, you can see these **round, tree-covered hills **in many parts of the city.
text_zh: 蘇克雷部位於多丘陵的地形中，因此可以在其街道上看到許多地勢起伏。獨特的是，你在城市的多個區域都能看到這些**被樹木覆蓋的圓形丘陵 **。

text: Sucre has a well-preserved **historic city centre**, with lots of old colonial buildings. The downtown area can be recognized by the white walls, orange tiled roofs, and generally more historic look than other places in Bolivia.
text_zh: 蘇克雷擁有保存完好的**歷史城區中心**，有許多古老的殖民時期建築。市中心區域可以透過白牆、橘色瓦片屋頂，以及比玻利維亞其他地方更具歷史感的外觀來辨識。

text: Potosí is also situated in a very **hilly** landscape, like Sucre. However, its landscape is much more **arid**, with little to no trees atop the hills.
text_zh: 波托西也像蘇克雷一樣部位於非常**多丘陵**的地形中。然而，它的景觀要**乾旱**得多，山頂上幾乎沒有樹木。

text: In many parts of Potosí, you can see this colossal pyramid-shaped mountain called **Cerro Rico**. It is famous for having massive quantities of silver ore, and as a result its surface is stripped bare by extensive mining – which is distinctly visible in the street view coverage.
text_zh: 在波托西的許多地方，你可以看到這座被稱為**富裕之山**（Cerro Rico）的巨大金字塔形山峰。它以擁有大量銀礦而聞名，因此其表面因大規模採礦而被剝光——這在街景覆蓋中清晰可見。

text: Santa Cruz is the only large Bolivian city located in a **tropical** (and flat) landscape.
Note that there are several smaller towns around Santa Cruz that look essentially identical. Some of these have extensive side-road coverage too.
text_zh: 聖克魯斯是玻利維亞唯一部位於**熱帶**（且平坦）景觀中的大城市。
注意，聖克魯斯周圍有幾個小鎮看起來基本上完全相同。其中一些小鎮也有大量的旁道街景覆蓋。

text: Ruta 1 west of El Alto is a paved road that runs through green grasslands. The road itself is mostly flat, but you will usually see hills nearby. On the road, you will often see **numbers marked in white paint**.
Near the western end of the road, close to Desaguadero and the border with Peru, you will be able to see Lake Titicaca [to your north](https://goo.gl/maps/36TPhoLYEQC9t3SX8).
NOTE: This road can look very similar to Ruta 2 northwest of El Alto. Road angles can help if you are not sure.
text_zh: 埃爾阿爾托以西的 Ruta 1 是一條穿過綠色草原的鋪設道路。道路本身大多平坦，但你通常會在附近看到丘陵。在路面上，你經常會看到**用白漆標註的數字**。
在這條路的西端附近，靠近 Desaguadero 與秘魯邊境處，你將能在[北方](https://goo.gl/maps/36TPhoLYEQC9t3SX8)看到的的喀喀湖。
註：這條路看起來可能與埃爾阿爾托西北方的 Ruta 2 非常相似。如果不確定，道路角度會有幫助。

text: The section of Ruta 3 around Pongo, northeast of La Paz, can easily be recognised by the breathtaking views of **enormous mountains**, which are often surrounded by low-hanging clouds. The mountains are also recognizable by their [dark grey rocks](https://goo.gl/maps/vr7NDxSPDkjH5tbKA) lightly covered in greenish grass.
text_zh: 拉巴斯東北方 Pongo 周圍的 Ruta 3 路段很容易透過**巨大山脈**的壯麗景色來辨識，這些山脈往往被低垂的雲霧包圍。這些山脈也可藉由微覆綠草的[深灰色岩石](https://goo.gl/maps/vr7NDxSPDkjH5tbKA)來識別。

text: The N Yungas Road (also popularly known as **Death Road**), is a bendy, small and unpaved road, high up in the mountains east of La Paz. The vegetation is very tropical. The coverage in the southern part of the road is very foggy. True to its unofficial name, this road looks like a very dangerous drive. You can sometimes see some [daring cyclists](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7).

NOTE: The northern half of this road looks [less foggy and dangerous](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7). However, it should still be recognizable, as it is the only dirt road meandering through jungle hills in Bolivia.
text_zh: 北雲加斯路（N Yungas Road，俗稱**死亡之路**）是一條蜿蜒、狹窄且未鋪設路面的道路，位於拉巴斯以東的高山深處。植被非常具有熱帶特色。該路段南部的街景覆蓋大霧瀰漫。名副其實，這條路看起來開起來非常危險。你時常可以看到一些[大膽的自行車騎士](https://goo.gl/maps/paLV6Q6yFCrpgxHn7)。
註：這條路的北半段看起來[霧氣較少，也沒那麼危險](https://goo.gl/maps/qrdtAg2G1jLGSWGP7)。不過，它仍然應該很容易辨認，因為這是玻利維亞唯一蜿蜒穿過叢林丘陵的泥土路。

text: Ruta 1 and 4 between La Paz and Oruro is a large **divided highway** that runs through the Altiplano landscape of western Bolivia.

It is the only large, divided highway in the entire country. There are smaller, divided roads in and near some urban areas, but those should be easily distinguishable based on landscape and road size.
text_zh: 拉巴斯和奧魯羅之間的 Ruta 1 與 4 是一條大型**分隔公路**，穿過玻利維亞西部的阿爾蒂普拉諾高原景觀。
這是全國唯一的大型分隔公路。在一些城鎮區域內或附近有較小的分隔道路，但根據景觀和道路大小應該很容易區分。

text: A long section of Ruta 4 has a distinctive **square smudge** on the front left of the camera. This coverage starts in the altiplano near Vila Vila, going east through Cochabamba, all the way to Buena Vista in the flat Amazonian part of Bolivia.
text_zh: Ruta 4 的一大段路段在相機左前方有一個獨特的**方形污漬**。這段街景覆蓋始於 Vila Vila 附近的高原，向東穿過科查班巴，一路延伸到玻利維亞平坦亞馬遜區域的 Buena Vista。

text: Around Morochata, northwest of Cochabamba on Ruta 25, there is a small isolated piece of coverage that looks **extremely similar to Peru**. It is a dirt road that meanders through a mountainous landscape. Knowing this road can be extremely helpful for country streak purposes.
The western part of this road is located in a [green mountain landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8), with fields on the mountain slopes and lots of eucalyptus trees around.
Towards the east, it transitions into a more [arid high altitude landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6) that still looks very similar to Peru.
text_zh: 在科查班巴西北方 Ruta 25 的 Morochata 周圍，有一小段孤立的街景覆蓋，看起來**極度類似秘魯**。這是一條蜿蜒穿過山區景觀的泥土路。了解這條路對於連勝國家模式非常有幫助。
這條道路的西段位於[綠色山脈景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/XYS5bkYquerLYR4C8)中，山坡上有農田，周圍有許多尤加利樹。
向東延伸，它轉變為更加[乾旱的高海拔景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/HSCxmB1jeaQpXrfP6)，看起來仍然非常像秘魯。

text: Ruta 1 between Machacamarca and Guindal runs through an arid landscape where you will often see patches of **snow on the hilltops**, and sometimes even [next to the road](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8). Weather conditions range from **cloudy to fully overcast**, lending this coverage a gloomy look.
The aforementioned road can be regionguessed even more precisely. See the next two tips.
text_zh: Machacamarca 和 Guindal 之間的 Ruta 1 穿過乾旱的景觀，你經常會看到**山頂上有積雪**，有時甚至會出現[在路邊](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8)。天氣狀況介於**多雲到陰天**之間，賦予這段街景覆蓋一種陰沉的外觀。
上述道路可以進行更精確的區域猜測。請參閱接下來的兩個提示。

text: The section north of Challapata runs in a general **NNW direction**, with straight roads in flat terrain, with hills on one or both sides. Weather conditions are a little bit better, with some of the sky visible, especially when [looking south](https://goo.gl/maps/oftxnXzA4Dfp4QACA).
text_zh: Challapata 以北的路段大致呈**北北西走向**，平坦地形上有筆直的道路，單側或雙側有丘陵。天氣狀況稍微好一點，可以看到部分天空，尤其是[向南看](https://goo.gl/maps/oftxnXzA4Dfp4QACA)的時候。

text: The section southeast of Challapata tends to be more **curvy and hilly**. The weather is much worse, with grey skies.
text_zh: Challapata 以東南的路段往往更加**蜿蜒且多丘陵**。天氣差得多，天空一片灰濛濛。

text: The section of Ruta 7 between Mairana and the outskirts of Santa Cruz has coverage with a camera bug that causes a **visual glitch**. It is a distinctive, neon-like discoloration, that (depending on the road angle) is usually more or less to your north.

NOTE: This glitch can also rarely be found in some limited areas [in and around Santa Cruz](https://goo.gl/maps/gzShbw98LU89oBtr8). In these areas, the glitch is often [not as severe](https://goo.gl/maps/f32GeQXxUbt7VYFK7).
text_zh: Mairana 與聖克魯斯郊區之間的 Ruta 7 路段，其街景覆蓋帶有相機錯誤引起的**視覺故障**。這是一種獨特的霓虹燈般變色，（取決於道路角度）通常或多或少位於你的北方。
註：這種錯誤極少數也會出現在[聖克魯斯境內及周圍](https://goo.gl/maps/gzShbw98LU89oBtr8)的某些有限區域。在這些區域，錯誤通常[沒那麼嚴重](https://goo.gl/maps/f32GeQXxUbt7VYFK7)。

text: The roads around the town of Mataral have recognizable coverage: a **very green, hilly** landscape, and **sunny weather** with only a couple of clouds. While the hills are very green, the vegetation is not very dense, and quite low.

This coverage is limited to Ruta 7 from Comarapa to Mairana, and Ruta 22 to Vallegrande. Other roads in Bolivia with similar vegetation tend to either have different weather (overcast) or terrain (more flat).
text_zh: Mataral 鎮周圍的道路擁有可辨識的街景覆蓋：**非常翠綠、多丘陵的**景觀，以及只有幾朵雲的**晴朗天氣**。雖然丘陵非常翠綠，但植被並不茂密，而且相當矮小。
這段街景覆蓋僅限於從 Comarapa 到 Mairana 的 Ruta 7，以及前往 Vallegrande 的 Ruta 22。玻利維亞其他具有類似植被的道路，要麼天氣不同（陰天），要麼地形不同（更平坦）。

text: In the aforementioned Mataral area, you will often see large **cacti** hiding between the bushes, as well as **trees with yellow flowers**.
text_zh: 在上述的 Mataral 區域，你經常會看到隱藏在灌木叢中的大型**仙人掌**，以及**開著黃花的樹木**。

text: The **eastern section of Ruta 4**, east of Santa Cruz, runs in a general east-west direction, through a mostly flat, green landscape. In some places, you can see some low hills. This road has both asphalt and concrete pad sections.
text_zh: 聖克魯斯以東的 **Ruta 4 東段**大致呈東西走向，穿過大部分平坦、翠綠的景觀。在某些地方可以看到一些低矮的丘陵。這條道路同時擁有柏油路段和混凝土板路段。

text: The section of Ruta 5 around Chaco, just north of Sucre, has distinct **sunset coverage**. Most of this road has concrete pavement, and meanders through semi-arid hills.
text_zh: 蘇克雷正北方 Chaco 周圍的 Ruta 5 路段擁有獨特的**夕陽街景覆蓋**。這條道路的大部分鋪有混凝土路面，並蜿蜒穿過半乾旱的丘陵。

text: The section of Ruta 4, southwest of Patacamaya, runs through a semi-arid grassland landscape. Many parts of that road between Patacamaya and Callapa have **worn-down grainy asphalt**.
text_zh: Patacamaya 西南方的 Ruta 4 路段穿過半乾旱的草原景觀。Patacamaya 和 Callapa 之間該道路的多個路段擁有**磨損的顆粒狀柏油路面**。

text: On the southwesternmost section of Ruta 4, you can usually see the **Nevado Sajama**, an isolated snow-capped volcano that is very distinct and unlike any other mountain in Bolivia.
When you see Sajama, you will always be south of Callapa and the Desaguadero River. However, you will not always be able to see it on this section of the road, as it is often hidden by hills.
NOTE: The only other place where you can see Nevado Sajama is coverage in the National Park, which is recognizable by its unique Google car.
text_zh: 在 Ruta 4 最西南端的路段上，你通常可以看到**薩哈馬火山**（Nevado Sajama），這是一座孤立的雪山火山，非常獨特且與玻利維亞的任何其他山脈都不同。
當你看見薩哈馬火山時，你一定位於 Callapa 和德薩瓜德羅河以南。然而，你在這段道路上並不總能看到它，因為它經常被丘陵遮擋。
註：唯一能看到薩哈馬火山的其他地方是國家公園內的街景覆蓋，該處可透過其獨特的 Google 車來辨識。

text: The section of Ruta 6 between Tarabuco and Zudáñez is paved with **extremely light-coloured concrete**, bordering on white. This pavement is very recognizable and unique to this road.
text_zh: Tarabuco 和 Zudáñez 之間的 Ruta 6 路段鋪有**顏色極淺的混凝土**，接近白色。這種路面非常容易辨認，且是這條道路獨有的。

text: Between the villages of Villa Vitalina and Coipasa, there is an isolated stretch of coverage where the Google car drove through **extremely arid** desert terrain. This small road is located close to the southwestern end of Ruta 12, near the Chilean border. It can be hard to spot on the map, because it blends in with the salt flat.

Closer to Villa Vitalina, the car drove over the [salt flat](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9). Closer to Coipasa, the car drove on an unpaved dirt road, where you can see [cone-shaped volcanic hills](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7). In both parts, there is virtually no vegetation.
text_zh: 在 Villa Vitalina 和 Coipasa 村莊之間，有一段孤立的街景覆蓋，Google 車駛過了**極度乾旱的**沙漠地形。這條小路位於 Ruta 12 的西南端附近，靠近智利邊境。在地圖上可能很難注意到，因為它與鹽沼融為一體。
靠近 Villa Vitalina 時，車輛駛過了[鹽沼](https://goo.gl/maps/8e9bmY6Fiih6gB5e9)。靠近 Coipasa 時，車輛行駛在未鋪設路面的泥土路上，在那裡你可以看到[錐形的火山丘陵](https://goo.gl/maps/vGForqRVdK6vjo9V7)。這兩個部分幾乎都沒有植被。

text: **Sajama National Park** was covered by this unique Google car: it has a black roof rack with a series of metal bars.

The coverage is on an unpaved road surrounded by fluffy bushes. The Nevado Sajama volcano is always [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7). The car briefly drove through the small village of [Tomarapi](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6), which can be recognized by its traditional buildings with adobe walls and thatched roofs.
text_zh: **薩哈馬國家公園**是由這輛獨特的 Google 車拍攝的：它有一個帶有一系列金屬桿的黑色車頂架。
街景位於一條周圍環繞著蓬鬆灌木叢的未鋪柏油道路上。薩哈馬火山始終[清晰可見](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7)。Google 車曾短暫駛過小村莊[托馬拉皮](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6)，該村莊以其擁有adobe泥磚牆和茅草屋頂的傳統建築而聞名。
